notes: «قال قال لي محمد بن المنكدر ما اسمك قلت شعبة» makes Muhammad the source Shu'ba got the report from (rule 5); the later «فقال محمد حدثني» is the same man, so one link
«حدثني أبي» is the father of عبد الوارث, unnamed in the text: relation
the Companion سويد is the last link: his own words «أما علمت» and «لقد رأيتني» are relayed; the order of the matn is the report's, not a second chain
